summary.pt: Alternância inteligente entre rácios 16:9 (desktop) e 1:1 (mobile) com formatos WebP/JPEG e prevenção de salto de layout (CLS).
summary.en: Smart aspect-ratio switching between 16:9 (desktop) and 1:1 (mobile) with WebP/JPEG formats and zero CLS.

purpose.pt: Ensinar a servir a imagem exata para cada contexto visual, poupando dados móveis e evitando Cumulative Layout Shift através de aspect-ratio.
purpose.en: Teach serving optimal images for each screen context, saving mobile bandwidth and preventing Cumulative Layout Shift with aspect-ratio.

purpose.en: Understand native browser hardware-accelerated touch gestures using scroll-snap-type and scroll-snap-align.
